name: io.github.bountyoperator/bounty-operator
title: Bounty Operator
description: Argues against a security finding or a draft bug bounty report before you submit it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Connection token from the account panel at bountyoperator.com. The account and run_review tools use it; every other tool works with none.

headers.name: X-Provider-Key
headers.description: API key of the model provider that run_review calls.
